name: g86_belly_faint_setboost
purpose: Step G86, found by the campaign of seed 86 (battle 42): Belly Drum of a burned Snorlax (Belly Drum at +6 stage, then the burn of the same step faints it). The -setboost stage is read against the stage at the step start; the faint clears the stages after the step, so the post-step check does not apply to it.
